surface: The select editor, a native select over the cell: opening it, choosing an option with the arrow keys, and Enter committing it.

steps.note: Enter opens the editor on the cell holding `D1`, a native select with the options Option A and Option B. `D1` is not an option, so the select shows nothing chosen and no value is required: only the control's role, which each reader words its own way (NVDA `combo box`, VoiceOver `pop up button`). Unsure: the role words of Firefox and WebKit.

The editor answers ArrowDown itself and chooses the next option (a script sets it, so the native popup does not open on macOS). Unsure: a change made by script on a focused select may be announced late, or not at all.
Enter commits Option B and moves the selection one row down (enterMoves), so the cell announced is the next row's, which holds `D2`. The first page of the paginated grid holds both rows.
ArrowUp returns to the edited cell, which now holds the committed option, `Option B`.
